feature_name: Enhanced backup/recovery appliance monitoring and alerting
summary: Backup and DR now adds enhanced logging and alerting for backup/recovery appliances, including proactive monitoring with Cloud Logging email notifications for status changes or potential issues.
extended_definition: Backup and DR now adds enhanced logging and alerting for backup/recovery appliances, including proactive monitoring with Cloud Logging email notifications for status changes or potential issues.
